ios.desc:
Drop ink on water and comb it into patterns the way Ottoman marblers have for five centuries. Ebru simulates the marbling bath in real time: every new drop pushes the colors already floating there, and every comb drags the whole pattern along with it.

Tools of the craft
Battal splatter, single drops, leaf drops and sprinkles lay the ground. Styluses, rakes, combs and the classical figures shape it: Tide, Shawl, Nightingale Nest, Tulip, Bloom, Peacock, Bird Wing, Thistle, Fan Comb, French Curl, Tornado and more. Each tool keeps its own settings in Tool Studio.

Layers that stay organized
Gather layers into groups, collapse them, and give a group its own opacity and blend mode. Clip a layer to the one below it so new ink lands only inside that shape. Undo names the exact step it takes back.

Symmetry
Mirror, rotation, tiling and spiral folds turn a single gesture into a mandala.

Color
Palettes drawn from Iznik tiles, manuscripts and miniatures, or one taken from a photo you pick.

Text, photos and adjustments
Place a photo or a line of text on its own layer, and grade any layer with curves, blur and gradient maps.

Apple Pencil
Pressure, tilt, hover, double-tap and squeeze, at 120 Hz on ProMotion displays.

Your works
Auto-save keeps every step. Works travel through your own iCloud between iPad and iPhone. Save PNG or JPEG to Photos at up to 4K, or share the .ebru file and reopen it later.

Privacy
Your art stays on your devices and in your own iCloud. The camera opens only when you take a palette from a photo, and that photo never leaves the device.
